Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few clarifications from Acme Procurement / Treasury:

1) We use Coupa (not Ariba)  we will need Redwood to either: (a) submit a supplier onboarding request in Coupa, or (b) send a completed vendor packet (vendor application + ACH form + W-9) to procurement@acmecorp.com and we will create the supplier record. Which do you prefer?

2) Required docs: completed vendor application, W-9 (current), ACH authorization form (with bank attestation), and a point of contact for invoice questions. We will also request a copy of your SOC 2 Type II report and a DPA to attach to the vendor file.

3) Timeline: once we have a fully completed packet and verified bank details, Coupa onboarding typically completes in 5-7 business days. If legal needs additional review of the DPA, add another 5-7 business days.

4) For pre-population of the Coupa record we will need Redwood's legal name, EIN, vendor remit address, and primary AP contact. If you could provide those fields we can speed up the supplier creation.

I attached our standard Vendor Onboarding Checklist for reference.

Questions for your team: do you have a dedicated finance contact to receive ACH/non-PO communication? Also, can you confirm the Redwood legal entity name you plan to use on the W-9 (this helps avoid rework in Coupa)?

Thanks  I can set target dates on our side once we know whether you will submit via Coupa or send the packet.

Regards,
Alice Johnson
Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Corporation
alice.johnson@acmecorp.com
